about: Every pattern in which the engine's commemorations differ from Missale Meum, 1962-2100, with the rubric that decides it. The counts are frozen: a new difference, or a change in a count, fails the test.

patterns.why: St. Barbara is commemorated on 4 December; Missale Meum has her only in its Polish proper.
On a 1st class day the privileged commemoration of an Advent feria is made. Missale Meum omits it.
A 1st class feast that is not of the Lord keeps the Sunday as a privileged commemoration. Missale Meum omits it.
On a 2nd class feast the one commemoration admitted is the privileged one of the Advent feria. Missale Meum omits it.
A 4th class day admits two commemorations. Missale Meum keeps only one on Our Lady on Saturday.
On the Friday of Passion Week the impeded 3rd class feast is commemorated after the Seven Sorrows, two being admitted. Missale Meum keeps only the Seven Sorrows.
The greater litanies are a privileged commemoration in the Mass, also within the Easter octave from Tuesday. Missale Meum omits them.

patterns.pattern: c2 vigil: ours+[feast c3] mm+[commemoration c4]
patterns.why: On the Vigil of the Ascension only one commemoration is admitted, the 3rd class feast (Missale Meum lists it as a second celebration and commemorates a 4th class saint instead).

patterns.pattern: c2 sunday: ours+[commemoration c4] mm+[feast c2]
patterns.why: On a 2nd class Sunday the 2nd class feast of St. Mark is omitted because the privileged commemoration of the greater litanies is made.
A 1st class Sunday admits only privileged commemorations, so no 4th class saint.

patterns.pattern: c2 feast: ours+[vigil c2] mm+[feast c2]
patterns.why: Sts. Philip and James are celebrated and the Vigil of the Ascension is commemorated (see oracle-deviations.json).
On Low Sunday, 25 April, the greater litanies stay on their day and are a privileged commemoration in the Mass.

patterns.pattern: c2 feast: ours+[vigil c2] mm+[commemoration c4]
patterns.why: The Queenship is celebrated with the Vigil of the Ascension as its one commemoration (see oracle-deviations.json).
On Saturday 16 July the Saturday office of Our Lady excludes the commemoration of Our Lady of Mount Carmel; the Missal lets the Mass be either one. Missale Meum commemorates her.
